verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation documents a switch that turns on dark mode, so users can flip between light and dark built-in appearances. That is a narrow version of switching between multiple themes. A community report also notes Adwaita-styled Flatpak apps ignoring the distro theme, so the restyle may not reach the whole desktop. Missing for 10: a choice of more than light/dark built-in themes, evidence that switching restyles every app consistently, and independent hands-on confirmation of theme switching.
